verdict.rationale: Remote documents an official MCP server that lets users ask an AI client questions like "How many people do we have in Portugal?" and get answers from live data. It also offers write tools for submitting time off and updating personal details. First-party agent skills for Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Gemini CLI accept natural-language requests such as "Export a headcount report as CSV." Missing for 10: natural-language write actions beyond employee self-service (e.g., admin, contract or payroll operations), a native in-product natural-language assistant rather than reliance on an external AI client, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
